motivation: Stage18 selected lambda48 on seed42 but failed seed41/43 confirmation. All three K2 cells improved over lambda0, motivating a new, explicitly post-hoc-derived K2 hypothesis. Old K2 cells are not reused as confirmatory evidence.
scope: Twelve new mutually user-disjoint K2 requests, each one train-frequency lower-tercile and one middle-tercile user with exactly two occurrences in the existing 3200-slot window. Four masked slots per request, matching original paper K2. Exclude all four old K2/K4 users. Require five Development examples per user. No outcome/label/prediction-based choice or replacement.
selection: Retain historical frequency terciles (count then p3c1-tercile hash). Within eligible role pools, order by SHA256('bota-stage19-k2-frozen-v1:{role}:{user}'), take first12 in each role and pair by index. Freeze all12 before any new-request model computation. Abort rather than relax rules if pools are insufficient.
parameters: Primary lambda48, no-Fisher lambda0, secondary unchanged MovieLens lambda64. No additional lambda search, per-request calibration or selection from seeds. Lambda1 is a nonselecting implementation-control state, not another evaluated candidate. Baselines are formal Original and matched Exact-Masked, not legacy Amazon BOTA endpoints.
evaluation: Seeds41/42/43 share historical pretrained model, data, order and all request identities; vary fixed-A/runtime seed. Score all3840 Development examples for each endpoint and all10 local examples per request. Reused Development, not a fresh holdout; new request identities, not new dataset samples. Requests share models and some training context, so clustered intervals are conditional diagnostics, not independent population-level significance.
mechanism_gate: For primary lambda48: finite results, no collapse and utility damage <=0.005 AUC and <=0.01 logloss in all36 cells. Versus lambda0, each seed's equal-request mean EU improves by >=1e-6 absolute AND >=1% relative; at least8/12 requests improve in the three-seed mean; the 2.5th percentile of paired request-cluster bootstrap mean EU gain is >0 (5000 resamples, seed190042; same resampled request indices across seeds). Any missing/numerically failed primary cell fails the gate without exclusion.
reconstruction_gate: Only after mechanism gate passes, require the same seedwise gain, request-win and bootstrap criteria versus Original (Original EU equals DU). Label this conditional matched-counterfactual support, not privacy erasure or broad transfer. If only mechanism gate passes, report mechanism-only evidence. Otherwise stop as unsupported/boundary evidence. Lambda64 results are secondary and cannot rescue the primary decision.
reporting: Publish all36 cells for each evaluated lambda, absolute EU and DU, residual, Toward-Exact Rate, per-user errors, aggregate utility, zero/small reference-signal counts, per-seed/request summaries, worst cells and bootstrap intervals. No favorable-cell filtering, selective user replacement, or automatic further optimization. No attacks, long horizons, compression, baseline retuning or paper rewrites in this stage.
integrity: Use Stage18v2 formal canonical-gradient convention; compare every shard canonical exactly with its sealed Stage18v2 Original; tensor-exact same-trajectory lambda1 theta/m/v control at every transport step. Separate atomic artifacts, frozen hashes, per-bank/per-request/per-prediction resume, and failed diagnostics retained. Original preregistrations and Stage18 outcomes stay read-only.
